verdict.rationale: Brex documents its own card management for employees: the Team API manages users, departments and cards, and the platform offers global corporate cards and team-issued vendor cards. A community report confirms Brex ships physical cards, but nothing explicitly documents issuing physical cards to individual employees tied to defined roles. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of physical card issuance to employees, debit card option, role-based card assignment or permissions, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can issue physical debit or credit cards to employees with defined roles

citations.quote: Team API: Manage users, locations, departments, and cards
Brex is the first fully unified spend platform — with global corporate cards, expense management, reimbursements, travel, and bill pay.
Issue vendor-specific cards for any teams with per-transaction limits and procurement approval flows.
